title: Google Play Store Adds a Section for Buying Phones and Accessories! 🛒
body: Google Play Store Adds a Section for Buying Phones and Accessories! 🛒

Google Play added a new option today called "Shop Devices," which lets you discover Google's hardware products right inside the store. The option has started rolling out gradually in selected regions, including India; it sits in the account-switcher menu inside the store and offers a shortcut to the Google Store.

Simply put: the store you download apps from now sells the phones themselves — Google wants you to buy a Pixel phone without ever leaving the app. In some regions, Galaxy S26 phones are also appearing in the list. The rollout is gradual, region by region, so it may not have reached your country yet.
Would you buy your phone from the app store itself? 📱
